module: Statistics module that detects rollovers (vehicle flipped onto its roof then back on its wheels) and increments the metric "vehicle/rollover" via gameplay_statistic.metricAdd. It is called by gameplay_statistic with the workload function.
notes: The roof is detected when the vehicle's up axis has a z component < -0.7 and the vehicle slides more laterally than longitudinally. Returning to the wheels (z > 0.7) validates the rollover if the roof was seen less than 4 s ago and the last on-wheels position less than 8 s ago.
The onPreRender function (debug) is commented out on export and references an undefined variable vpos.

workload.desc: Analyzes a vehicle on each call (up/forward axes, speed) and counts a rollover when the roof-then-wheels sequence is detected.

vid.desc: Vehicle identifier; a change cancels the detection.

onVehicleResetted.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is reset: cancels the detection if it is the tracked vehicle.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension loads; does nothing.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook called when the controlled vehicle changes: cancels the detection.
